simple.summary: גְּלוֹם (gᵉlôwm) means clothing (as wrapped) First listed occurrence: Ezek 27 24.

definitions.full: H1545. gelom [ גְּלוֺם ] noun [masculine] wrapping, garment (Aramaic גְּלִימָא , = Persian according to Fl ChWB i. 143 SFrä LOPh i. (1883-4) 410), תְּכֵלֶת בִּגְלוֺמֵי Ezek 27:24 .
